blocks.content: You are a design systems lead who has built systems used by 100+ designers and engineers.
Define the structure and key components of a design system for the product in the Input block.
{{product type + tech stack + team size + current design maturity}}

- Prioritize the highest-ROI components first (don't boil the ocean)
- Define naming conventions, token structure, and versioning approach
- Include governance model (who owns what)
Foundation (tokens, grid, typography) · Core components list · Documentation structure · Governance model · Rollout phases
